credit.description: Required attribution, e.g. the TALOD credit.

MapPosition.description: A uiMap position, normalized 0..1 from the top-left like `types::Position`.

PlanarEntranceEstimate.description: A planar entrance estimate; elevation is intentionally absent.

allowable_class.description: Class and race bit masks; -1 means every class or race.

buy_price.description: Copper. `vendor_sold` says whether a vendor sells it; a price alone does not.

made_by.description: Recipe spells that create this item.

obtain_hint.description: How a raw material is obtained, in words (e.g. `Mining`, `Herbalism`).

stats.description: Stat name (source vocabulary, e.g. `stamina`, `armor`) to amount.

colors.description: Orange, yellow, green and grey thresholds; 0 means the colour is absent.

makes.description: Average items made per craft (at least 1).

source_inferred.description: The learning source was inferred by a rule, not listed by the source.

hours.description: Server hours `[from, to)`, wrapping past midnight.

season.description: `[from, to]` as month * 100 + day, wrapping past New Year.

level_range.description: Lowest and highest creature level found in the area by the generator.

rank.description: 0 normal, 1 elite, 2 rare elite, 3 boss, 4 rare.

trainer_class.description: Class trained, as a class ID, for class trainers.

required_skill.description: Lock or skill requirement for gathering nodes and chests, when known.

position.description: Unsupported when the map has no uiMap (instances without a region).

prev_quest.description: Positive: must be completed; negative: must be active.

reward_money.description: Copper; negative means the quest costs money.

zone_or_sort.description: Positive: area ID; negative: quest sort (class, profession, holiday).

ranks.description: Spell ID per rank, in rank order.

chance.description:
Percent; negative marks a quest-only drop (CMaNGOS); 0 inside a group means
an equal share of the group's remainder.

item.description: Exactly one of `item` or `reference` is set.

revision.description: Upstream revision (commit, dump name or build); absent for live pages.

snapshot_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the retained snapshot or of the cache manifest that lists them.

build.description: Unknown until the 1.0.0 target build is frozen (ADR 0006 §1).

WorldPoint.description: A point in a map's world coordinates (yards), as server data stores it.

description: navzeroth-world-data v1 shard. Absent optional fields mean the source did not provide them (unknown), never zero. Structural validity is not a rights grant or a verified Forever fact.

dataset.description: Dotted dataset name, for example `professions.recipes` or `world.spawns`.

title: WorldData
